verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents downloading a Page as an Excel workbook that keeps its formulas. That is a real first-party export path, but it works page by page and is not a complete data export. MCP read access to the Model is a developer building block, not an export feature, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: bulk or full-account export of all data, export of chats, changelog and connected-source data, other open formats such as CSV or JSON, documented account closure or offboarding, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
